identity.title: [v0.92][AWS tooling][defect] Retain exact remote builder preflight failure diagnostics

deliverables: Exact failed-check diagnostic with exit status.
Simulated missing-tool regression and runner retention contract.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every builder preflight check has a stable label and records its exit status.
AC-2: Early failure retains exact redacted stdout, stderr, and toolchain diagnostics in portable artifacts while removing raw temporary captures.
AC-3: The owner summary identifies the precise failed check and missing executable rather than only stage plus exit 127.
AC-4: Existing exact-owner instance, IAM, security-group, and zero-resource cleanup semantics remain unchanged.

AC-5: Focused tests simulate a missing executable, dynamically prove normal-path runner emission and raw-capture removal, and prove missing diagnostic emission cannot block summary or cleanup compatibility.
AC-6: Fresh exact-head review, required CI, merge, typed finish, terminal cache, and ancestry complete before #268 retries.
dependencies: Consumes the completed #268 failure observation without claiming which executable was previously missing.
non_goals: Changing provider, instance, image, or cleanup policy.
Speculating about the executable missing in the completed paid attempt.
